brand_guidelines.mission: Simplifying financial management for freelancers and solopreneurs
brand_guidelines.vision: A world where every freelancer can focus on their craft, not their bookkeeping
brand_guidelines.brand_promise: We turn financial chaos into clarity with tools built for the way you actually work.
key_messages: Know exactly where your money is going
Tax season? We've got you covered

psychographics.tech_savvy: High — use multiple digital tools daily

pain_points: Spend hours on bookkeeping each month

tone_of_voice.voice_characteristics: A straight-talking accountant who's also your biggest cheerleader. Cuts through the jargon, makes you feel capable.

tone_variations.formal: For tax documents and financial reports — precise, compliant, professional
tone_variations.casual: For social media — punchy, funny, uses memes and pop culture references
tone_variations.urgent: For tax deadline reminders — direct, action-oriented, creates urgency without panic
tone_variations.empathetic: For onboarding and support — patient, celebrates progress, never judgmental

do_say: You've got better things to do than bookkeeping
Save hours. Save money. Sleep better.

visual_identity.logo_usage: Flow icon (three ascending lines) should always point upward-right. Clear space equals the height of the icon. Blue on white, white on blue backgrounds.
visual_identity.imagery_style: Clean, organized desk setups. Real freelancers in their natural workspaces. Bright, airy photography with pops of blue and teal. Avoid cluttered finance imagery.
